headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and leading-none. H1 should be text-4xl to text-5xl.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, labels, and standard text. leading-relaxed.

labels.usage: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-widest) for chart labels, table headers, overlines.

layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8
layout.spacing: Generous spacing for sections (py-12). Dense spacing within cards (p-6).

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm
surfaces.card: Flat solid: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

components.buttons: Flat design, bg-primary text-white hover:bg-orange-700 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors. Focus: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-orange-500
components.dropdowns: Shadcn Select component. Flat styling, crisp borders. Use for Year and Genre filters.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Left-aligned data. Use IBM Plex Sans. Distinct hover state on rows (hover:bg-gray-50).
components.charts: Shadcn Chart / Recharts. Ensure clear tooltips, use the custom chart colors defined above. Hide grid lines if possible for a cleaner look, or use very light dashed lines (#F3F4F6).

motion.hover: Subtle transform (-translate-y-0.5) on cards, fast transitions (duration-150 ease-out)

image_urls.description: Abstract data shapes. Use as a very subtle background layer in the header or empty state (opacity 10-20%) to add texture.
Wooden library shelves. Optional use for a login/auth page background if needed.

icons.usage: Use crisp, 1.5x stroke width icons. Avoid filled icons unless active state.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. e.g., data-testid='year-filter-select'.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over any background meets WCAG AA (APCA preferred). Hover states must explicitly set text color.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components as per the environment stack, rather than Streamlit.
The layout should follow a 'Control Room' grid (grid-cols-4).
Filters (Year, Genre) should be prominently placed in a sticky header or a control bar below the main title.
Summary cards go in the first row (1 col each).
Charts (Top Authors, Genre Dist, Trends, Scatter) take 2 cols each.
Correlation Heatmap and Data Table span the full 4 columns.
Inject fonts from Google Fonts/Fontshare in index.html or global css: 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Card, Select, Table) use flat, crisp styles with subtle borders to match the Swiss High-Contrast archetype.
Create a FastAPI backend to serve the data for the charts and tables.
